title: Posting Insurer-Approved Extensions as Covered Days (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Billing clause.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, an extension the insurer approved is posted on the rental as an insurer-paid authorization naming the approved extension request.

An insurer extension is posted on the rental only after the courtesy days the network owes for its own delay on the same repair stand on the reservation.

An authorization adds its days to the covered days on the rental ledger; it does not itself move the coverage end recorded on the reservation, which only the desk's coverage-end update sets.

## Business effect

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Rentals concerned | Insurance replacement rentals carrying an extension request the insurer approved |
| What the authorization names | The approved extension request, and the insurance claim repair order the rental is for |
| Who pays | The insurer |
| Observable effect | One covered-day authorization naming the approved request, with that request's ground as its reason and paid by the insurer, stands on the reservation in the rental's day and money history, dated the day it is posted; the rental's covered days grow by its days |

## Posting tool: `authorize_insurer_extension_days_b8e4d7d7`

**Capability.** Posts an extension the insurer approved as covered rental days paid by the insurer on an insurance replacement rental. One covered-day authorization naming the approved extension request, with that request's ground as its reason and paid by the insurer, is added to the rental's day and money history, dated today; the rental's covered days grow by the days given.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `authorize_insurer_extension_days_b8e4d7d7` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_reservation_id` | Reference number of the rental reservation, as returned by the rental reservation lookup | Id |
| `claim_repair_id` | Reference number of the insurance claim repair order the rental is for, as shown on the reservation and returned by the claim repair lookup | Id |
| `extension_request_id` | Reference number of the insurer-approved extension request being posted, as returned by the rental extension request lookup | Id |
| `authorization_number` | Ordinal of this authorization on the reservation: one more than the highest authorization number already on the rental | Integer, 1 or more |
| `days_count` | Extension days authorized | Integer count of rental days |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("authorized" when the authorization was recorded), `rental_entry_id` (reference number of the new authorization entry), `rental_reservation_id` (the reservation), `extension_request_id` (the approved request named), `authorization_number` (integer ordinal), `authorization_reason` (the request's ground: `repair_delay_supplement`, `parts_delay` or `total_loss_settlement`), `paid_by` (always "insurer"), `days_count` (integer days authorized) and `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD).

## Contract illustration (hypothetical)

Posting a request whose ground is a parts delay, on a reservation whose highest authorization number is 2, with an `authorization_number` of 3 and a `days_count` of 4, returns a receipt whose `authorization_reason` reads "parts_delay" and whose `paid_by` reads "insurer".
